info.title: Gtw Redes Service Test Management
info.description:
## TMF API Reference: TMF653 - Service Test Management

### Release : 20.0 - April 2020

Service Test Management API goal is to provide the ability to manage tests of provisioned Services. This OpenAPI specification contains the endpoints and attributes which are supported by this implementation of the TMF standard 

### Resource 
- ServiceTest 
- ServiceTestSpecification

### Operations
Service Test Management API performs the following operations on the resources :
- Retrieve an entity or a collection of entities depending on filter criteria
- Create an entity (including default values and creation rules)
- Delete an entity (for administration purposes)

### Tracing Headers
Both `X-Vivo-Transaction-Id` and `X-Vivo-Correlation-Id` are **required** for `POST /serviceTest`, as this operation triggers an asynchronous diagnostic flow where both IDs are essential for end-to-end correlation with the callback. For all other synchronous `serviceTest` operations (`GET`, `GET/{id}`, `DELETE/{id}`) both headers are optional but recommended for traceability. `serviceTestSpecification` operations do not use these headers.

### ExternalId — Correlação entre Request e Callback
O campo `relatedParty` do `ServiceTest` deve incluir uma entrada com `role: ExternalId` contendo o identificador gerado pelo sistema consumidor (SalesForce ou ServiceNow). Este ID é enviado no request, ecoado pelo HPSD no callback e utilizado para correlação ponta a ponta, mitigando o risco de timing entre o callback e a persistência do ID interno do HPSD nos sistemas consumidores. O ID interno do HPSD (`body.id`) permanece como identificador oficial para consultas históricas.

post.description: This operation creates a ServiceTest entity.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: JWT Bearer Token

parameters.name: X-Vivo-Transaction-Id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the transaction, generated by the originating system (e.g. SalesForce, ServiceNow). Used for end-to-end traceability across all integrated systems. Should be a UUID v4.

**Obrigatório no `POST /serviceTest`** pois o fluxo é assíncrono e ambos os IDs são necessários para correlação com o callback. Nos demais endpoints síncronos é opcional, porém recomendado para rastreabilidade.

parameters.name: X-Vivo-Correlation-Id
parameters.description:
Correlation identifier used to link asynchronous events and callbacks to the originating request. Must be echoed back in the callback event body field 'correlationId'. Should be a UUID v4.

**Obrigatório no `POST /serviceTest`** pois o fluxo é assíncrono — sem este ID não é possível correlacionar o callback com a requisição original. Nos demais endpoints síncronos é opcional.
